thought.text: The `sva_enqueue_job` function and `graphile_worker` schema are provisioned by `deploy/portainer/migrate-graphile-worker.mjs` (part of the bootstrap path). Let me examine it to see if I can run it locally to provision the job-worker DB.

reasoning_content:
In other words, `sva_enqueue_job` is created by `deploy/portainer/migrate-graphile-worker.mjs` (a bootstrap/migrate path). This is part of the deployment bootstrap, executed by the ghcr image (which cannot be pulled) or by the remote swarm migrate job. The local path (`pnpm env:migrate:local-*` / `data:db:migrate`) only runs goose migrations, and does not provision the graphile_worker schema or sva_job_worker role.

Let me look at migrate-graphile-worker.mjs to confirm — this is what creates the graphile_worker schema + sva_enqueue_job + sva_job_worker role grants. It's possible to run this locally to fully provision the job worker's DB. That's a reasonable local prerequisite (like bootstrap-app-user). Let me read it.
